originals.why: Here 'isio' takes a noun object, so the ~고 싶어 pattern from the gloss can't be used. 원해 is the only natural Korean. The Welsh is natural.

originals.ko: 너는 지금 멈추고 싶은 게 확실해?

topups.why: Its Welsh is fine, but it only repeats 'stopio' and the top-up count is already filled by stronger rows.

The prompt has two possible answers. 웨일스어로 이야기하다 is already used for 'siarad Cymraeg' in o2, so a learner could also say 'siarad Cymraeg' here instead of 'siarad yn y Gymraeg'. A statement-shaped question could also draw 'wyt ti isio'.
Its Welsh is fine, but it is long and has many parts, and the count is already filled.
